title: TaCo: Targeted Concept Erasure Prevents Non-Linear Classifiers From Detecting Protected Attributes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accuracy of linear and non-linear classifiers (e.g., Multilayer Perceptrons, Logistic Regression) in predicting gender from latent representations of biographies in the Bios dataset after applying the Targeted Concept Erasure (TaCo) method, along with applying the COCKATIEL explainability technique to interpret the semantic meaning of the erased concepts.
